inconsistency_1_zeroshot_resnet18_confus.question: Zero-shot discovery ResNet-18 on the 250-patient subset: confusion matrix [[17380,242],[9472,6602]] vs [[17380,242],[9473,6601]]
inconsistency_1_zeroshot_resnet18_confus.explanation_of_discrepancy: In standard inference across the 33,696 slices (batch_size=128 in torch.inference_mode(), saved in brats_250_leakage_free_baseline_predictions.csv.gz, leakage_free_baselines.json, and brats_250_5seeds_with_cis.json), the confusion matrix is [[17380, 242], [9472, 6602]] (TP=6,602, FN=9,472). In run_gradcam_brats_evaluation.py (saved in gradcam_brats_evaluation.json lines 123 and 272), forward passes were run only on the 16,074 tumor-positive slices with batch_size=64 and requires_grad_(True) enabled; due to cuDNN/FP32 reduction order differences between batch_size=128 (all slices) and batch_size=64 (tumor slices only), 1 boundary tumor slice close to 0.5 shifted across the 0.5 threshold, yielding 6,601 TP and 9,473 FN in the Grad-CAM subgroup count. For standard classification evaluation (batch_size=128 on all 33,696 slices), [[17380, 242], [9472, 6602]] is the exact value.

inconsistency_2_patient_split_imagenet_r.question: Patient-split ImageNet ResNet-18: [[16683,939],[1490,14584]] vs [[16682,940],[1490,14584]], and PR-AUC 0.9791 vs 0.9776
inconsistency_2_patient_split_imagenet_r.explanation_of_discrepancy: Both the saved prediction file (paper_evidence/brats_250_leakage_free_baseline_predictions.csv.gz) and the saved metrics file (paper_evidence/leakage_free_baselines.json lines 81-91) agree 100%: confusion_matrix = [[16683, 939], [1490, 14584]] and pr_auc = 0.9791319069413886 (0.9791). The values [[16682, 940], [1490, 14584]] and PR-AUC 0.9776 came from an aborted earlier run (task-2506) that crashed at KeyError: 'overlapping_patient_ids' before saving JSON, and were erroneously quoted in chat text. The authoritative saved files on disk have [[16683, 939], [1490, 14584]] and PR-AUC = 0.9791.

inconsistency_3_cheng_3class_strict_pati.question: Cheng 3-class strict patient split: train/val slice counts 2,103/499 vs 2,175/427 (test = 462 in both)
inconsistency_3_cheng_3class_strict_pati.explanation_of_discrepancy: The saved file paper_evidence/leakage_free_baselines.json (lines 454-456) records the exact slice counts for the 163 train / 35 val / 35 test patient split (np.random.default_rng(42).permutation(sorted(unique_pids))): n_train_slices = 2,103, n_val_slices = 499, n_test_slices = 462 (total = 3,064). The numbers 2,175/427 were from an ad-hoc chat calculation using a different patient sort order and do not appear in any saved file.

inconsistency_4_250_subset_last_digit_ro.question: 250-subset values that differ in the last digit between exports (e.g. ResNet-18 5-seed mean accuracy 0.6235 vs 0.6236)
inconsistency_4_250_subset_last_digit_ro.explanation_of_discrepancy: In paper_evidence/brats_250_5seeds_with_cis.json (line 371), the exact 5-seed mean accuracy of ResNet-18 computed from unrounded floating-point values is 0.6235517568850902, which rounds to 4 decimal places as 0.6236 (line 376: '0.6236 +/- 0.0787'). If one instead averages the 4-decimal-place rounded per-seed numbers (0.7117 + 0.6451 + 0.5265 + 0.5578 + 0.6766) / 5 = 3.1177 / 5 = 0.62354, that rounds to 0.6235. The exact unrounded mean is 0.623552 (0.6236 at 4 decimal places).
